rows.text: On 2 December 1997 the Secretary-General laid on the Table the Prime Minister's (I. K. Gujral's) letter dated 28 November 1997 to the President tendering his own resignation and that of his Council of Ministers (Library LT 2434/97).

locator.page_heading: XI Lok Sabha Debates, Session VI (Winter), Tuesday, December 2

rows.text: The papers include the President's letter dated 28 November 1997 to Gujral accepting his resignation and that of his colleagues (LT 2435/97).
The President's letter of 28 November 1997 requests Gujral to continue in office till alternative arrangements are made.
